title: Aakar Template Descriptor v1
description: What a parametric template publishes about itself: parameters with ranges, anchors for text and motifs, handles for morph nodes, constraints and allowed materials. Served by the geometry service and cached by the API.

environment.description: Viewer backdrop: an environment id from the reference data (experience.v1.json environments, packages/design-tokens/experiences.json; GET /api/environments).

hardware.description: Bought-in parts this template's pockets, holes and slots are cut for; authoritative over the family default.

min_feature_mm.description: Smallest printable stroke or detail (0.8 mm for a 0.4 mm nozzle); text and silhouette checks use it.

connector.description: Hybrid (Jod) templates only: the Kadi cut into the piece so it plugs into a bought-in base. The female feature is always on the printed Chhaap (it prints flat, no supports); the male side belongs to the base or to the bought-in adapter adapter_sku. Kadi-S is the ribbed press socket; Kadi-D the dovetail channel (form-free, slide fit); Kadi-T a thread or an E27 / E14 shade collar; Kadi-M the magnet pockets or steel-disc pocket; Kadi-C the compliant rim clip (cap skirt, lid lip or rim jaws), PETG only.

nominal_mm.description: The pin (rail, thread, magnet) diameter the base presents, e.g. 12 for a Kadi-S Ø 12.

fit.description: The as-printed condition the connector is modelled for; press_ribbed = three crush ribs take up the pin's variation.

clearance_mm.description: Diametral clearance between the printed bore wall and the pin (flank clearance for a rail, radial for a thread, pocket clearance for a disc, lip over-travel for a clip).

form.description: rim_clip only: a skirt over a cap, a lip inside an opening, or C-jaws over a rim.

thread.description: thread only: the standard; e27 and e14 are collar holes clamped by the holder's shade ring, not threads.

mode.description: magnet only: magnets in pockets, or one steel disc that holds to the base's magnet.

adapter_sku.description: hardware_items sku of the bought-in male part packed when the base has no pin of its own.

handle.description: Exposed as a draggable morph handle in the viewer.

group.description: UI grouping, e.g. Size, Shape, Details.

anchor.description: A named place where content may land: a surface (text, motif, relief) or a volume (a customer's own 3D form). size_mm/bounds_mm are the 3D analogue of a print area; bleed_mm the safe margin inside it.

size_mm.description: Printable width and height of a surface anchor.

bleed_mm.description: Content stays inside size_mm minus twice the bleed.

bounds_mm.description: Width, depth and height of a volume anchor; content is scaled to fit.

accepts.description: Feature types allowed on this anchor; defaults to the template's features_supported.

max_relief_mm.description: At least 0.4 mm, the shallowest text depth, so every accepted feature can fit. Cap for relief_image.relief_mm (emboss and deboss) and emboss depth on this anchor. relief_image in lithophane mode is exempt: the plate itself is the relief and the template's lithophane hook owns its thickness range.

modes.description: The only modes content may take on this anchor: raised (emboss), cut in (deboss) or the photo as the plate itself (lithophane), e.g. ["deboss"] on a frame that prints face down, ["lithophane"] on a night-light plate. Absent: every mode the feature type allows. A feature that leaves mode out takes its type's default (emboss_text and relief_image emboss, motif deboss), which must then be listed, so clients send the mode explicitly.

required.description: The piece cannot be built without content on this anchor (the night-light plate needs its photo). Clients ask for it up front; the API and the geometry service refuse a design without it.
